gateC.disc_status: ALL 18 experiments: acc=1.0 (saturated), style_r=exp-floor constant (~0.015-0.035). AMP never provided meaningful imitation signal. Policy walks via task reward only.
gateC.root_cause: DISTRIBUTION problem: single short expert clip (337 frames, highly structured walking pattern) vs random-init policy is trivially separable by discriminator. All regularization approaches (spectral norm, GP=5-20, label smoothing, feature norm, 350-dim stacked obs, official reward) failed to prevent saturation.
gateC.pivot_direction: From opposite hypothesis: (1) iter-0 separability probe to confirm distribution issue, (2) diversify expert dataset with multiple clips/speeds, (3) pretrain policy to walk before AMP fine-tuning, (4) consider state-action discriminator
